title: Mutations
html:
Mutations

Mutations are a type of crop created in the Greenhouse. They are created by arranging crops in specific patterns around an empty soil plot and grant special positive and/or negative effects.

Mutations can be analyzed in the Crop Analyzer, accessed either via the  Underground Lab or by calling Jake on an Abiphone. Analyzing a mutation for the first time grants bonus Copper and contributes to the DNA Analysis Milestone.

Mutations can be stored in the  Mutations Sack. The recipes for it are unlocked at DNA Analysis Milestone I (1), DNA Analysis Milestone III (3), and DNA Analysis Milestone V (5).

Modifiers

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Greenhouse

This section needs more information. Please help expand it.

See more stubs.

Placed Mutations affect their surrounding Mutations and Crops. These effects will lock once the Mutation or Crop reach their final stage. Furthermore planting unique Crops in Greenhouse will give +3% Yield and +2.5% Growth Speed per, up to 12 times ( Moonflower and  Sunflower count as the same crop, same for  Red Mushroom and  Brown Mushroom).
